name: onio
description: Read and change your Onio wishlists from Claude.
long_description:
Lets Claude read your Onio wishlists and wishes, including Private and Archived ones. Claude can also create and change wishlists and wishes. It cannot delete or share them.

The permissions of your token decide what Claude may do. If Claude only needs to look, create a token with only the “Read wishlists and wishes” permission. Claude asks you before each change. Read what it wants to change before you allow it.

The extension runs on your computer. Claude Desktop keeps your token in the keychain of your operating system. The extension sends your data only to Onio and has no analytics. Your AI provider sees what Claude reads.

tools.name: list_wishlists
tools.description: Lists your wishlists, including Private and Archived ones.

tools.name: get_wishlist
tools.description: Gets one wishlist with all its wishes.

tools.name: search_wishes
tools.description: Finds wishes by title, description or link.

tools.name: create_wishlist
tools.description: Creates a wishlist. It starts as Private. Changes your data.

tools.name: update_wishlist
tools.description: Changes the title, occasion or notes of a wishlist. Changes your data.

tools.name: add_wish
tools.description: Adds a wish to a wishlist. Changes your data.

tools.name: update_wish
tools.description: Changes a wish. Changes your data.

api_token.title: Personal access token
api_token.description: Create a token in API Access in your Onio profile. It starts with onio_pat_. Its permissions decide what Claude may do.
